row: I have been a veterinarian for over 20 years and have been a home euthanasia and vet for the last 10 years. I currently run my own home euthanasia business. DISCLAIMER: Our focus is mainly on end-of-life care in pets diagnosed with terminal diseases.  In videos discussing specific diseases, our primary focus is on end-of-life questions we are commonly asked. Our videos only briefly discuss the diseases themselves, diagnosis and common treatment options.  Because Veterinarian medicine is always changing and improving with specific treatments, please be sure to continue to research your pet's diagnosis. There may be new and better treatments available through your Vet, Oncologist, and Veterinary Universities with clinical trials and research.  As time goes on, our posted videos are unchanging, So I encourage you to also check out disease specific forums, for many times there will be recommendations on new treatments you can discuss with your Vet, that may benefit your pet.
